style: Children's picture-book illustration, flat shapes, thick dark-brown ink outline, no gradients, warm cream paper background (#FBF6EC), limited palette: warm tan fur, ruby red, navy blue, golden yellow, sage green. Main character is the puppy from the first reference image: round tan head, cream muzzle, pink cheeks, small dark eyes, upright ears, ruby-red scarf — keep him exactly recognisable, now drawn full-body. Second character: a small grey tabby cat with a navy-blue collar. Square composition, single comic panel, no text, no letters, no speech bubbles, no captions, no border.

frames.scene: The puppy walks along a sunny Georgian village road carrying a fishing rod over his shoulder. The grey cat sits on a low stone fence and looks at him curiously, head tilted.
The puppy proudly holds up his fishing rod and a small bucket, pointing with a paw toward a river visible far away between hills. The grey cat listens.
The grey cat stands alone on a long empty road that stretches far to the hills, looking small, worried and unsure, ears down. The puppy is a few steps ahead, looking back at him.
The puppy and the grey cat stand at a small village bus stop. A little golden-yellow minibus is arriving. The puppy happily points at the minibus.
At the river bank. The grey cat sees the water, is horrified, and is turning around and walking away up the path back home. The puppy holds his fishing rod and looks after him in surprise.
Warm sunset by the river. The puppy stands with a bucket that has one fish tail sticking out, fishing rod on his shoulder, waving goodbye with a paw, smiling.
